:::{#def-logarithm}
#### Logarithm

Let $b$ be a positive [real number](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers) with $b \ne 1$.
For every real number $x > 0$,
the **logarithm** of $x$ to the [base](#def-power-base) $b$ [@wikipedia_logarithm],
written $\log_b x$,
is the real number $y$ for which the [real power](#def-real-power) $b^y$ is $x$.

:::
